description: Repo-scale (sql-ecommerce): a new order_discounts table must be netted into customer_order_totals, not just created
prompts: Add a new table `order_discounts` to schema.sql: `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY`, `order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id)`, `discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (discount_cents > 0)`. Creating the table alone isn't enough - `customer_order_totals` in views.sql must actually subtract each customer's total discounts from their gross total_cents (summed across all their orders' order_discounts rows), not just keep summing order_items as before. `product_sales_summary` is unaffected by discounts and should be left as-is.

test_setup_files.check_discounts_netted.py:
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

schema = Path('schema.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
views = Path('views.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

con = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
con.executescript(schema)
con.executescript(views)
con.executescript("""
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'Ada', 'ada@example.com');
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 1000);
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', '2026-01-01');
INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (1, 1, 1, 2, 1000);
INSERT INTO order_discounts VALUES (1, 1, 300);
""")

total = con.execute(
    'SELECT total_cents FROM customer_order_totals WHERE customer_id = 1').fetchone()[0]
assert total == 1700, (
    f'expected 1700 (2000 gross - 300 discount), got {total} - customer_order_totals '
    f'must subtract order_discounts, not just the raw order_items sum')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0)
           - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(od.discount_cents)
                       FROM order_discounts od
                       JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = od.order_id
                       WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id), 0) AS total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

files.views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) AS total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
